T18.note: real only for multi-permutation ordered/categorical fits

T22.note: Default ON in IDENTICAL; `_OFF` is the incumbent storage. trees:rf.route: fit: fit_forest -> RowSampler (RF_SAMPLE) -> batched_levelalgo Builder.enqueue_best_splits (T05 fused | histogram T02/T04/T08 + find_best_splits T07) -> node split (C48) -> device level loop (T11); predict: core/forest_inference launch_forest_inference (FOREST_ROUTE, T33, T34)
trees:rf.note: T03 does not fire on the default sqrt classifier or regressor; T14 regressor only
trees:rf.notes: Only T12=256MiB T12=1024MiB T13=4MiB T13=16MiB reach this lane.

trees:et.route: fit: extratrees batched_levelalgo builder (T05 <=128-row fused, T02 et_loop, C48, ET_LOOP_K T11); predict: core/forest_inference
trees:et.notes: Only T11_LEVELS=8 T11_LEVELS=16 T12=64MiB T12=256MiB T14=on reach this lane.

trees:gbdt-symmetric.route: fit: doc-parallel oblivious searcher, 8-bit hist2 (T21_STREAMS), C45 score fusion, leaf estimation (T23, T27); predict: resident model (C50_GB)

trees:gbdt-depthwise.route: fit: greedy_search_helper_depthwise (T19_DEFER, T21 group width, T18, C45 root, T26 RMSE leaf); predict: C50_GB

trees:gbdt-lossguide.route: fit: greedy_search_helper_depthwise lossguide exact batch (T17_BATCH, C47_GBDT, T19_DEFER, T21); predict: C50_GB

trees:gbdt-multiclass.route: fit: symmetric searcher, multi-dim leaf estimation (T23 off for blocked-Hessian); predict: C50_GB

trees:gbdt-categorical.route: fit: Plain Lossguide, 4 CTR permutations: CTR prep (T28 arms) + greedy_search_helper_depthwise lossguide (T17_BATCH, T19_DEFER, T21, T18 multi-permutation batch) + 8-bit hist2 (T21_STREAMS); predict: non-symmetric resident model (C50_GB | gbdt_ns_predict_bitvec)

trees:gbdt-ordered.route: fit: SymmetricTree Ordered boosting, 4 permutations, no categorical columns (T22, T24, T25); predict: C50_GB guarded

trees:gbdt-rank-yetirank.route: fit: yeti_rank objective (T29) + symmetric searcher; predict: C50_GB

trees:gbdt-rank-pairlogit.route: fit: pair_logit_group (T29 arms) + symmetric searcher; predict: C50_GB

trees:iforest.route: fit: isolation_tree_builder (T40, T41, C47_IF, C48_IF); score: isolation_forest (T42, C50_IF; T43 contamination variant)
